pages.text: [#](53341a)Some creatures are better studied after they have stopped moving.[#]()
pages.title: Creature Traps

pages.text: [#](53341a)The traps are low metal plates: place one, give it a moment to arm, and keep your own feet clear.[#]()
[#](53341a)Iron and shears. Once armed it catches living creatures, snaps shut for four damage, and applies strong slowness. Right-click to open or close it.[#]()
[#](53341a)Upgrade a Beartrap with Silver, Null Catalysts, and Wolfsbane. Werewolves trigger it; others do not. It drops nothing when broken.[#]()
